description: This file defines the Cart class within the Opencart e-commerce platform, specifically in the checkout module. It contains methods for retrieving cart products and calculating totals, interfacing with other models such as upload tools and total extensions.

classes.name: Cart
classes.description: Represents the shopping cart model, providing methods to access products in the cart and calculate totals.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves all products in the cart, including handling product options, images, and subscription details, and returns this data as an array.

methods.name: getTotals
methods.description: Calculates the total amounts and taxes for the items in the cart, by applying relevant total extensions and sorting the results.
